checkpointPayload.description: Nguoi dung muon lay design dep nhu Edge-Drop. Edge-Drop tokens: nen den nhieu lop #000/#060608/#0c0c10/#141418, glass rgba(12,12,16,.72), accent tim #8b5cf6 + glow rgba(139,92,246,.55), vien 1px sang trong + bong sau 0 30px 80px, bo goc blade 22px/card 14px/pill, spring overshoot cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) 140/240ms. Ap vao src/design/tokens.css giu mau ngu nghia ok/warn/crit + mirroring + reduced-motion. Lam o wave cuoi sau khi 2 subagent xong.
